scanNote:
63-BET. Unit 9 ochilish yoymasining o'ng beti — 'Now & Then' maqolasi.

Skaner bilan solishtirildi. Barcha javoblar TO'G'RI:
- 5 ta savol javobi maqola matnidan aynan chiqadi.
- Qalin yozilgan 8 ta ibora (west coast, seems, in fact, islander, reach, getting around, running water, in front of) to'liq qamrab olingan.
- THEN/NOW jadvalidagi olti qatorning hammasi matn bilan tasdiqlanadi.

RASMLAR: B = somon tomli tosh kulba, E = 'The Souvenir Shop', H = eshak, J = 'FIONA'S GUEST HOUSE'. Bu to'rttasi 62-betdagi 1-mashqning javoblarini to'ldiradi.

⚠ MANTIQIY TEKShIRUV: Colman Coneely — 70 yoshda va 'When I was young' deb ellik yil oldini eslaydi. Demak o'shanda u 20 yoshda bo'lgan. Izchil.

⚠ MA'LUMOT: matnda 'up to 2,000 tourists a day' deyilgan. Inishmore (irlandcha Inis Mor) — Aran orollarining ENG KATTASI; kitob uni 'a small island' deb ataydi, bu Irlandiyaga nisbatan to'g'ri.

⚠ 62-betdagi xaritada joy nomi xatosi bor ('Ourtnagapple') — batafsil izoh 62-bet qaydida.

exercises.explanationUz:
MAQOLA — 'NOW & THEN' (Hozir va o'shanda) RUKNI.

TUZILISHI:
  1-xatboshi: orol haqida umumiy ma'lumot
  2-xatboshi: ELLIK YIL OLDIN (o'tgan zamon)
  3-xatboshi: BUGUN (hozirgi zamon)
  4-xatboshi: orol aholisining fikri

BU MAQOLADA IKKI ZAMON QIYOSLANADI:
  O'TMISH: was, were, wasn't, weren't, had, didn't have,
           could, couldn't
  HOZIR:   is, are, have got, can

QALIN SO'ZLAR (4-mashqda tushuntiriladi):
  west coast, seems, in fact, islander, reach,
  getting around, running water, in front of

QAHRAMON: Colman Coneely — 70 yoshli orol aholisi.

sentences.en: This week on our Now & Then page, we are looking at Inishmore, a beautiful little island off the west coast of Ireland.
sentences.uz: Bu hafta 'Hozir va o'shanda' sahifamizda biz Inishmore — Irlandiyaning g'arbiy qirg'og'i yaqinidagi go'zal kichik orolni ko'rib chiqamiz.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'Z: the west coast = g'arbiy qirg'oq.
'OFF the coast' = qirg'oq yaqinida (dengizda).
'we are looking at' — Present Continuous (hozirgi son).

sentences.en: At first, Inishmore seems exactly the same as it was fifty years ago, but in fact it is a very different place today.
sentences.uz: Dastlab Inishmore ellik yil oldingidek ko'rinadi, lekin aslida u bugun butunlay boshqa joy.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'ZLAR:
  seems = ko'rinadi (aslida boshqacha bo'lishi mumkin)
  in fact = aslida, haqiqatda
'At first' = dastlab, birinchi qarashda.
'the same AS' = ...bilan bir xil.

sentences.en: Colman Coneely, a 70-year-old islander, says, "When I was young, few tourists could reach Inishmore."
sentences.uz: Kolman Koneli, 70 yoshli orol aholisi, shunday deydi: «Men yosh bo'lganimda kam sayyoh Inishmorega yetib bora olardi».
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'ZLAR:
  an islander = orol aholisi (island + -er)
  to reach = yetib bormoq
'a 70-YEAR-OLD islander' — chiziqcha bilan, 'years' EMAS.
'When I WAS young' — o'tgan zamon.
'COULD' = 'can' ning o'tgan zamoni.

sentences.en: "There wasn't an airport or any ferry boats in those days."
sentences.uz: «O'sha kunlarda aeroport ham, parom ham yo'q edi».
sentences.noteUz:
'There WASN'T an airport' — birlik inkor.
'or ANY ferry boats' — inkor gapda ANY.
'in those days' = o'sha kunlarda.

sentences.en: "There were only donkeys and small fishing boats for getting around."
sentences.uz: «Yurish uchun faqat eshaklar va kichik baliqchi qayiqlari bor edi».
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'Z: getting around = yurib turmoq, joydan joyga o'tmoq.
'There WERE' — ko'plik.
'FOR + fe'l-ING' = ...ish uchun.

sentences.en: "Life was difficult. We didn't have much money — we only had small stone cottages."
sentences.uz: «Hayot qiyin edi. Bizda ko'p pul yo'q edi — faqat kichik tosh kulbalarimiz bor edi».
sentences.noteUz:
'HAD' = 'have' ning o'tgan zamoni.
'DIDN'T HAVE' = o'tgan zamon inkori.
'much money' — sanalmaydigan ot bilan MUCH.

sentences.en: "We didn't even have electricity or running water!"
sentences.uz: «Bizda hatto elektr va vodoprovod ham yo'q edi!»
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'Z: running water = vodoprovod suvi (jo'mrakdan oqadigan).
'even' = hatto.
'electricity' = elektr (sanalmaydigan).

sentences.en: "Inishmore was a quiet place — there weren't any guest houses or restaurants back then."
sentences.uz: «Inishmore tinch joy edi — o'shanda mehmon uylari ham, restoranlar ham yo'q edi».
sentences.noteUz:
'There WEREN'T ANY' — ko'plik inkor.
'back then' = o'sha paytda.

sentences.en: Today, up to 2,000 tourists a day can visit Inishmore.
sentences.uz: Bugun kuniga 2000 tagacha sayyoh Inishmorega tashrif buyurishi mumkin.
sentences.noteUz:
'up to' = ...gacha.
'2,000 tourists A DAY' — 'a' = har (kuniga).
Bu yerdan HOZIRGI zamon boshlanadi.

sentences.en: "Now there is an airport," says Coneely. "There are also cars, buses, bicycles and big ferry boats."
sentences.uz: «Hozir aeroport bor, — deydi Koneli. — Mashinalar, avtobuslar, velosipedlar va katta paromlar ham bor».
sentences.noteUz:
'There IS' / 'There ARE' — hozirgi zamon.
Ikkinchi xatboshidagi 'There wasn't an airport' bilan solishtiring.

sentences.en: "Life is very easy now. We have got new, modern houses and a lot of money."
sentences.uz: «Hozir hayot juda oson. Bizda yangi, zamonaviy uylar va ko'p pul bor».
sentences.noteUz:
'Life IS easy' ↔ 'Life WAS difficult'.
'We HAVE GOT' ↔ 'We HAD' / 'We DIDN'T HAVE'.

sentences.en: "We have also got electricity and running water. Inishmore is very busy now."
sentences.uz: «Bizda elektr va vodoprovod ham bor. Inishmore hozir juda gavjum».
sentences.noteUz:
'also' — 'have' va 'got' ORASIDA turadi.
'Inishmore IS busy' ↔ 'Inishmore WAS quiet'.

sentences.en: "There are guest houses, restaurants and lots of souvenir shops."
sentences.uz: «Mehmon uylari, restoranlar va ko'plab sovg'a do'konlari bor».
sentences.noteUz: 'There ARE' ↔ 'There WEREN'T any guest houses or restaurants'.

sentences.en: Coneely looks across the green fields in front of his house and smiles.
sentences.uz: Koneli uyi oldidagi yashil dalalarga qaraydi va tabassum qiladi.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'Z: in front of = oldida.
'look ACROSS' = ...bo'ylab qaramoq.

sentences.en: "Yes, Inishmore is beautiful and we're working hard to keep it just like this."
sentences.uz: «Ha, Inishmore go'zal va biz uni shunday saqlab qolish uchun qattiq harakat qilyapmiz».
sentences.noteUz:
'work hard' = qattiq harakat qilmoq.
'keep it just like this' = uni shundayligicha saqlamoq.
'we'RE WORKING' — Present Continuous (hozirgi davr).

exercises.explanationUz:
Javoblarni maqoladan toping.
DIQQAT: 1-3 savollar O'TMISH haqida, 4-savol HOZIR haqida.

items.answer: It is a small island off the west coast of Ireland.
items.whyUz:
Maqolada: 'Inishmore, a beautiful little island off the west coast of Ireland'.
'OFF the coast' = qirg'oq yaqinida.

items.textEn: 2  Could many tourists reach the island fifty years ago? Why (not)?
items.answer: No, they couldn't. Few tourists could reach it because there wasn't an airport or any ferry boats.
items.whyUz:
'could' savoliga 'couldn't' bilan javob beriladi.
SABAB: 'There wasn't an airport or any ferry boats in those days.'
'few' = kam (deyarli yo'q).

items.textEn: 3  What did the islanders have for getting around?
items.answer: They only had donkeys and small fishing boats.
items.hintUz: O'sha paytda qanday transport bor edi?
items.whyUz:
Maqolada: 'There were only donkeys and small fishing boats for getting around.'
'did ... have' savoliga 'had' bilan javob beriladi.

items.textEn: 4  What can you find on Inishmore today that wasn't there fifty years ago?
items.answer: Today there is an airport, cars, buses, bicycles and big ferry boats. There are also new modern houses, electricity, running water, guest houses, restaurants and souvenir shops.
items.whyUz:
Bugun bor, lekin ellik yil oldin bo'lmagan narsalar.
Ikkinchi va uchinchi xatboshini solishtiring.

items.textEn: 5  What does Colman Coneely think of the island?
items.answer: He thinks Inishmore is beautiful. He and the other islanders are working hard to keep it just like this.
items.whyUz:
Koneli: 'Yes, Inishmore is beautiful and we're working hard
to keep it just like this.'
'think OF' = ... haqida fikrda bo'lmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Then, explain the words in bold.

items.whyUz:
'the west coast of Ireland' = Irlandiyaning g'arbiy qirg'og'i.
Boshqa tomonlar: the east/north/south coast.

'Inishmore SEEMS exactly the same' = xuddi o'shanday KO'RINADI.
'seem' — tashqi ko'rinish, haqiqat emas.

'but IN FACT it is a very different place' = lekin aslida u boshqa joy.
'seems' bilan qarama-qarshi qo'yiladi.

island + -er = orolda yashovchi odam.
Shu qoida: New York → a New Yorker;  village → a villager.

'few tourists could REACH Inishmore' = kam sayyoh yetib bora olardi.
DIQQAT: 'reach' dan keyin 'to' KERAK EMAS:
'reach TO Inishmore' XATO.

'for GETTING AROUND' = yurib turish uchun.
'get around' — frazali fe'l (transport haqida).
'for' dan keyin fe'l -ING bilan.

'electricity or RUNNING WATER' = elektr yoki vodoprovod.
So'zma-so'z 'oqar suv' — quvur orqali uyga keladigan suv.

'the green fields IN FRONT OF his house' = uyi oldidagi dalalar.
Aksi: 'behind' (orqasida).

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text again and make notes under these headings: THEN (what there was/wasn't & what the people had/didn't have) — NOW (what there is & what the people have got).
exercises.instructionUz: Matnni qayta o'qing va quyidagi sarlavhalar ostida qaydlar yozing: O'SHANDA (nima bor/yo'q edi va odamlarda nima bor/yo'q edi) — HOZIR (nima bor va odamlarda nima bor).
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL IKKI USTUNDAN IBORAT:

  THEN (o'shanda)              NOW (hozir)
  what there WAS/WASN'T        what there IS
  what the people HAD/         what the people
     DIDN'T HAVE                  HAVE GOT

ZAMONLAR JADVALI:
  O'TMISH              HOZIR
  there was/were   →   there is/are
  there wasn't/weren't → there isn't/aren't
  they had         →   they have got
  they didn't have →   they haven't got
  they could       →   they can

Bu jadval keyingi og'zaki mashq uchun REJA bo'ladi.

items.answer: There wasn't an airport. There weren't any ferry boats, guest houses or restaurants.
items.whyUz:
Maqolada: 'There wasn't an airport or any ferry boats in those days.'
'there weren't any guest houses or restaurants back then.'

items.answer: There were only donkeys and small fishing boats.
items.whyUz: Maqolada: 'There were only donkeys and small fishing boats for getting around.'

items.answer: They only had small stone cottages.
items.whyUz: Maqolada: 'we only had small stone cottages'.

items.textEn: THEN — what the people DIDN'T HAVE:
items.answer: They didn't have much money, electricity or running water.
items.whyUz:
Maqolada: 'We didn't have much money' va
'We didn't even have electricity or running water!'

items.answer: There is an airport. There are cars, buses, bicycles, big ferry boats, guest houses, restaurants and lots of souvenir shops.
items.whyUz:
Maqolada: 'Now there is an airport ... There are also cars, buses,
bicycles and big ferry boats ... There are guest houses, restaurants
and lots of souvenir shops.'

items.textEn: NOW — what the people HAVE GOT:
items.answer: They have got new, modern houses, a lot of money, electricity and running water.
items.hintUz: Koneli 'we have got' deb nima aytadi?
items.whyUz:
Maqolada: 'We have got new, modern houses and a lot of money.
We have also got electricity and running water.'

exercises.instructionEn: Now, look at your notes and talk about what Inishmore was like fifty years ago and what it is like now. Start like this: There wasn't an airport on Inishmore then. There were only donkeys and fishing boats ...
exercises.instructionUz: Endi qaydlaringizga qarang va Inishmore ellik yil oldin qanday bo'lganini hamda hozir qandayligini gapiring. Shunday boshlang: Inishmoreda o'shanda aeroport yo'q edi. Faqat eshaklar va baliqchi qayiqlari bor edi ...
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA BOShLANISh:
  'There wasn't an airport on Inishmore then.
   There were only donkeys and fishing boats ...'

QOLIP:
  O'TMISH: There was/wasn't ... There were/weren't ...
           People had / didn't have ...
  HOZIR:   There is/are ... People have got ...

FOYDALI BOG'LOVCHILAR:
  then / in those days / back then — o'shanda
  now / today — hozir
  but — lekin (qiyoslash uchun)

groups.explanationUz: Joy nomiga -er qo'shilib, o'sha yerlik odam nomi yasaladi.
Yosh otdan OLDIN kelsa, chiziqcha bilan yoziladi va -S QO'ShILMAYDI.

sentencePatterns.introUz: 63-betdagi asosiy qoliplar — o'tmish va hozirni qiyoslash.

patterns.exampleEn: There were only donkeys then. Now there are cars and buses.
patterns.exampleUz: O'shanda faqat eshaklar bor edi. Hozir mashinalar va avtobuslar bor.
patterns.explanationUz: O'tmish va hozirni qiyoslashning asosiy qolipi.

patterns.exampleEn: We only had small stone cottages. We have got new, modern houses.
patterns.exampleUz: Bizda faqat kichik tosh kulbalar bor edi. Bizda yangi, zamonaviy uylar bor.
patterns.explanationUz: 'have got' ning o'tgan zamoni — HAD ('had got' odatda ishlatilmaydi).

patterns.exampleEn: We didn't have much money. We didn't even have electricity.
patterns.exampleUz: Bizda ko'p pul yo'q edi. Bizda hatto elektr ham yo'q edi.
patterns.explanationUz:
O'tgan zamon inkori: DIDN'T + fe'l ASOS shaklida.
'didn't HAD' XATO.

patterns.exampleUz: Kam sayyoh Inishmorega yetib bora olardi.
patterns.explanationUz: 'could' dan keyin fe'l ASOS shaklida ('to' va '-s' YO'Q).

patterns.exampleEn: Inishmore seems exactly the same, but in fact it is a very different place.
patterns.exampleUz: Inishmore xuddi o'shanday ko'rinadi, lekin aslida u butunlay boshqa joy.
patterns.explanationUz:
'seem' — tashqi ko'rinish;  'in fact' — haqiqat.
Bu ikkisi doim qarama-qarshi qo'yiladi.

patterns.formula: up to + son + ot + A DAY.
patterns.exampleEn: Up to 2,000 tourists a day can visit Inishmore.
patterns.exampleUz: Kuniga 2000 tagacha sayyoh Inishmorega tashrif buyurishi mumkin.
patterns.explanationUz:
'up to' = eng ko'pi bilan.
'a day' = kuniga ('a' = har).
